_doc: R3 §3a — THE REVIEWED MAPPING over contract/census.js's inventory. Ordered rules, FIRST MATCH wins; every site must match exactly one rule (unmatched = RED). A rule maps to an R-site (PLAN §3) or EXEMPTS with a reason. P0 status: PROPOSED by the executor, for advisor review before P1 — the reasons are the review surface. Server-side readers are the send-boundary payload builders (push, WhatsApp, factura, stats, Sheets); every other functions file is a writer / validator / infrastructure and is exempted as such, by file, with its count visible in census.json.

surfaces.exempt: factura printer setup / seed scripts (operator tools, not order readers)
saves the just-confirmed order's address to the customer's profile from the CLIENT copy (a profile writer), not a persisted-order read
client order COMPOSER — the writer of the order body, covered as the WRITER (S1..S17 submit through it)

explicitProjections.reason: mapFirebaseOrderToCard assigns the local `estado` in if/else branches on o.status (xpizza-kitchen/index.html), then projects `estado: estado` — data flow a bounded syntactic rule cannot see (§3a: explicit mapping)

sentinelExemptions.reason: the customer's contact field (persisted on the order since launch) — not an order-email SENDER; §1's 'no order email' stands
PixelPay merchant configuration (pixelpay-config.js) — not an order field

xpizza-functions/index.js:chargeOnlineAp.reason: 1500 ms guest-attribution deadline (index.js 'deadline → guest; never delay/fail a payment') — REAL

xpizza-functions/index.js:sleep>anon:set.reason: the body of sleep() itself (index.js); virtualized only when called from a reviewed application-sleep site (§2b.5)

xpizza-functions/catalog/identity-record.reason: withTimer: the identity-record write deadline — REAL
race(): a labelled read/write timeout — REAL

xpizza-functions/catalog/identity-integr.reason: the identity-integrity monitor's default sleep() implementation for its read budget (catalog maintenance job, real time) — not an order-path timer

rate-limits the identity-integrity monitor's Firestore reads to ≤ READS_PER_SECOND in every 1 s sliding window — a catalog maintenance job, never on an order path; REAL time, not a scheduler-virtualized application sleep (reviewed at the R3 P0 rebase onto 445d85d)

clockReview._default: rule-proposed classes are accepted for P0 and listed for advisor review; per-site overrides go here as `file:fn:line-free-key → class`

serverCategories.intake: order INTAKE writer / validator (createOrder, chargeOnlineOrder, quotes, pricing, classification, display number) — produces the persisted evidence (§1) the readers are asserted against; its outputs are covered as writers
serverCategories.payment: payment / refund / reconciliation LIFECYCLE writer (PixelPay charge / confirm / webhook / cancel, materialize, cancel, manual resolve, sweeps) — persisted F-PAYLIFE evidence, covered as writers (S5–S10)
serverCategories.catalog: catalog / identity / publish / exposure infrastructure — reads catalog items and versions, not persisted orders
serverCategories.rewards: rewards LEDGER writer (earn / reserve / redeem) — persisted F-REWARD evidence, covered as a writer
serverCategories.scheduling: scheduled-order hold / release WRITER (S11) — persisted F-SCHED evidence
serverCategories.dispatch: assignment / driver location / attribution / task retention WRITER — persisted F-DRIVER / task evidence (S1, S1t, S1a, S13)
serverCategories.readytime: ready-time predictor / quality — shadow model, no customer or staff surface
serverCategories.infra: client floor / version / health / auth (OTP, account deletion) / rate-limit / alert-pruning infrastructure — no order fact displayed
serverCategories.fixtures: test FIXTURE module (required only by *.test.js) — not production
serverCategories.seed: operator seed / publish script — not an order reader
